plans.note: Separate caps for each party (9.1 IBM, 9.2 Customer) — check mutuality, cap amount/formula, consequential damages exclusion and carve-outs (indemnity, confidentiality, data breach). Sec 5.4 and 14.2 may add disclaimers/survival that interact with the cap.

IBM indemnity in 8.1 (test IP infringement scope, defence/settlement, remedies); Customer indemnity in 8.2 should stay narrow. Sec-1 appears to be the indemnification procedure sub-list (notice, control of defence). Confirm indemnities are carved out of the 9.1 cap.

No non-compete heading; 14.16 Freedom of Action is typically vendor-favouring (IBM free to compete) and does not restrict us. Scan 14.11 No Resale and the AUP for any restriction on the businesses we may operate.
Check 14.16 and the services/charges provisions for any sole-source or 'all requirements' language; none expected in an IBM hosting base agreement.
No pricing-parity heading; only flag if 4.1 Charges contains an MFN running against us. An MFN in our favour is not to be flagged.
14.8 Personnel is the likely home of any hiring/solicitation restriction; test whether it binds Customer, its duration, and whether general advertising/unsolicited applicants are carved out.

3.4 is the core clause — check whether termination for convenience is mutual, the notice period, and any termination charges/unamortised cost recovery in 3.4/3.5/4.1. Also confirm 3.3 cause rights are mutual with a cure period.
3.2 Renewal: test auto-renew term length, non-renewal notice window (prefer <=30 days), and whether renewal pricing uplift is capped in 3.2 or 4.1.

14.3 Choice of Law — confirm it is NY/DE/CA/E&W and that venue is courts rather than foreign arbitration; 14.4 jury waiver and 14.14 Actions Period (limitations shortening) are adjacent points to note, not duplicate flags.
14.10 Assignment — check we may assign to affiliates and to a successor by merger/asset sale without consent, and that IBM has no termination right on our change of control.

Ownership of Customer Content/data likely in 11.6 and 14.18; 12.1 License and 14.17 Limitation of Licenses define what IBM grants and retains. Confirm no assignment or broad licence of our data/IP to IBM and that data return survives per 3.5.
12.1 is the grant — test scope for affiliates and contractors/end users, revocability at will, geographic limits (14.19) and the negative scope in 14.17 and 14.11 No Resale.

11.3 Suspected Violations is the likely audit/inspection hook (access, suspension, investigation); test notice, frequency, off-site records review and who bears cost. If it is only a suspension right, treat the formal audit right as absent rather than deviant.
Check 4.2 for late-payment interest/penalties payable by us and 11.1 for any service-credit regime (credits in our favour are welcome). Liquidated damages against Customer unlikely to appear.

5.1 IBM warranties plus 11.1 support/SLA are the substance; 5.2 Exclusivity of Warranties and 5.4 Other Disclaimers likely disclaim implied warranties and any uninterrupted-service commitment. Assess duration and whether the remedy is real. 11.2 appears to be Customer-side warranties — do not flag those under this rule.
No insurance heading in the outline; 5.3 Security and 14.12 Risk of Loss are the nearest neighbours. Likely a missing-clause flag given IBM hosts our data.
Base Terms may push commitments to Order Forms; check 4.1 Charges and 11.5 Capacity Planning for committed volumes/minimums and whether any take-or-pay has an exit tied to 3.4.

3.5 Effect of Termination is the place to test for data return/export in a usable format, a wind-down or transition assistance period, and deletion obligations; 14.2 Survival should carry these forward.
